thread:
Aisha CSM: Heads up team — HelixMed QBR scheduled Thu 11am PT. Customer is worried about 'unexpected' spend and onboarding friction. Need a short token-econ slide, risks, and an enablement ask. Drop quick facts and blockers here.

Tom FinOps: Short spending snapshot for the slide:
```
Estimated monthly tokens: 1.75M
Avg rate: $2.25 per 1k tokens
Projected monthly spend: ~$3,937
MoM change: +55% (onboarding + nightly re-embed)
Anomaly: 2025-05-09 spike correlated with bulk schema import
```

Rahul CS: Onboarding status: 78% complete. Left: schema mapping edge-cases, API key rotation, and a requested live prompt workshop for the clinical ops team. Renewal sentiment: wary unless cost trend stabilizes.

Maya Support: We observed a retry loop causing an embedding storm during the import spike. Logs show 500k embed calls retried rapidly. I can add client-side concurrency limits and add a progress checkpoint to avoid retries.

Ben Enable: I can lead a 30-min 'cost-aware prompts' session and a short checklist for their ML engineer to follow post-QBR. Available Wed 10am PT. Will prepare two before/after prompt examples and a quick runbook for throttling.

Tom FinOps: Two clarifications for the QBR slide: are batch re-ingests run off-peak? Also are they using caching of embeddings? If hosted, suggest batching + embedding cache + shorter context windows for interactive flows.

Aisha CSM: They run the bulk import at night but without chunking; caching not enabled yet. They have a hybrid setup: hosted + one private endpoint for PHI. Biggest cost driver: nightly re-embed of new clinical notes (~400k docs).

Rahul CS: Suggestion: try an incremental embed pipeline (only new/changed docs) + a lightweight model for batch jobs. I'll prototype an incremental flag in their ingestion and report delta.

Maya Support: I'll implement chunking (25k docs) + exponential backoff in staging tonight. Plan to promote to prod tomorrow AM if green.

Tom FinOps: If incremental + lightweight model are feasible, I can produce a two-scenario spend projection for the QBR (current vs mitigated). Need sample run numbers: tokens/sec and avg latency from the lightweight run.

Rahul CS: I'll run a 12-hour prototype of incremental embed + 8-bit model variant and capture sample metrics. ETA: tomorrow 6pm PT.

Ben Enable: I'll include the runbook steps in the enablement doc: chunking, backoff, embedding cache TTLs, and prompt token-budgeting heuristics.

BillingBot: Billing alert: "HelixMed usage exceeded projected baseline by 48% on 2025-05-09" — ticket #BILL-9622 opened.

Aisha CSM: Action items — (1) Rahul: prototype incremental embed + 8-bit sample (ETA tomorrow 6pm PT) (2) Maya: staging chunk/backoff patch (ETA: staging tonight, prod AM) (3) Tom: two-scenario spend model for QBR (ETA tomorrow 4pm PT) (4) Ben: enablement slides + invite (ETA: Wed 10am PT) (5) Aisha: consolidate deck and add renewal risk notes. Please confirm ETAs below.

Tom FinOps: Confirmed — cost slides ready by tomorrow 4pm PT.

Rahul CS: Confirmed — sample run posted by 6pm PT tomorrow.

Maya Support: Staging deploy tonight; prod target 7:30am PT pending tests.

Ben Enable: Slides and invite scheduled; will upload materials to the shared folder.

Aisha CSM: Thanks — I'll stitch the deck once numbers land. Marking the nightly re-embed as a top renewal risk and include proposed mitigations. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
